input.prompt: The classic New York City sidewalk litter basket: a round, open-top, slightly tapered steel basket painted dark green, about waist high, its wall a dense criss-cross lattice of thin flat steel bands woven diagonally into small diamond-shaped openings (like a woven wire mesh), stiffened by three thick solid horizontal steel hoops: a rolled rim at the top, one around the middle and one near the bottom, and a solid green band at the base. A black plastic bin liner fills the inside, so the mesh is backed by the black bag and you cannot see through the basket. Product photo for 3D reconstruction: exactly one object, shown whole and centred with a generous empty margin on every side, nothing cropped. Three-quarter front view from slightly above (camera about 20 degrees above the horizon and about 35 degrees off the front axis), a long lens with little perspective distortion. Isolated on a plain, seamless, uniform pure white background. Soft, even, diffuse studio lighting from all around: no harsh highlights, no cast shadow or contact shadow, no floor, no reflections of surroundings. No other objects, no people, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no badges, no watermark. Photorealistic, sharp, accurate real-world proportions and materials.
